title: Prefered audios workaround
summary: 1. Use Manasa Krishna Prabhu recordins as much as possible. 2. Search and use Kamal Krishna Prabhu recordings. 3. Allow mark individual tracks (like in case of Manasa Krishna's or Nabadwip) as "good for pronunciation". 4. Split audio section on song into two parts: "learn" and "variations" - give correct namew for groups. 5. Find other ways to show "other" audio, to keep it, but not mix with proper pronunciation. For example it can be page with all audios at all, grouped by songs or singers.
